rationale: Implements the selected region (the complete eager module stack executed during accumulate_microbatches) as a single dispatch-minimized replacement at its root boundary: observed module call 49ba48f70fed6e18c832ea15 (target 'gpt2', GPT2LMHeadModel.forward, count 4 per step, kwargs input_ids/labels/use_cache per the observed signature). Measured basis (selection rationale, observations/current): the accepted parent step is 131-139 ms while rank-0 GPU busy work is only ~8.6 ms forward kernels + ~23.4 ms backward compute + ~63 ms serialized bucket allreduces, leaving on the order of 50 ms of host-side dispatch gaps around a few thousand tiny eager kernels (nsys: 25.7 ms GPU busy spread over 107 ms of pre-communication wall); the parent forward executes ~670 aten dispatches plus 151 nn.Module.__call__ boundaries per micro-batch through the HF wrapper stack (mask re-derivation with 4 arange + 12 unsqueeze + where per call, a padding-warning path that ends in aten._local_scalar_dense, i.e. a host sync, per call, output recorders, Conv1D/LayerNorm/Embedding wrappers). The replacement is a flattened same-order eager reimplementation of exactly the parent computation: every compute kernel (F.embedding x2, add, native_layer_norm x25, addmm x48, bmm x24 with the identical folded operand shapes/strides/storage-offsets the parent's matmul folding emits - verified against the recorded aten trace: q (12,128,64)/(64,2304,1) off 0, k^T (12,64,128)/(64,1,2304) off 768, v (12,128,64)/(64,2304,1) off 1536, mul by scaling 0.125, broadcast mask add, _softmax, second bmm, transpose+contiguous-clone, mm with the tied head weight, constant_pad_nd, _log_softmax, nll_loss_forward) is emitted with identical operand values, so loss, logits, every gradient and every updated parameter are bitwise identical to the parent; CPU verification on the installed worker libraries (torch 2.13.0+cu129, transformers 5.16.1) shows bitwise-equal loss, bitwise-equal all-parameter gradients after 4-micro-batch accumulation, and a compute-op skeleton with zero value mismatches for the full 12-layer config. Removed work is host-side only: per-micro-batch aten dispatches drop from ~670 to ~447 (measured 2720 -> 1788 per 4-micro-batch step, -932), 151 module boundaries collapse into one (600 fewer __call__ traversals per step), the constant causal mask and position ids are hoisted to a once-per-(device,seq_len) cache built with the same values the parent recomputes each call, the padding-warning host sync (aten._local_scalar_dense) is gone, and no-op p=0.0 dropout and identity views are skipped. Backward is untouched: the flattened forward builds the same autograd graph over the same live parameter tensors, so DDP reducer hooks, no_sync accumulation semantics, gradient_as_bucket_view aliasing and the SGD update are exactly the parent's. Communication is deliberately not touched. Previous-feedback repair: the prior trial-b0a02885e2 candidate replaced the two c10d.allreduce_ groups with a Python-orchestrated chunked isend/irecv exchange and was rejected on paired measurement (230.5/234.1 ms vs parent 131.0/139.1 ms, paired_gain_not_above_noise, objective_not_improved; its wrapper also added ~2.3 ms per-bucket rank skew). This attempt follows the new region selection instead: it leaves all NCCL dispatch, bucketing and process groups untouched and attacks the measured host-dispatch gap only, with bitwise-identical numerics instead of a transport change. Expected effect (hypothesis, to be decided by the paired A/B measurement): step_ms falls by roughly the removed forward host time (~8-15 ms of the 131-139 ms step) toward the GPU-bound floor (~34 ms compute + ~63 ms serialized allreduce tail); if the clean run is instead GPU- or sync-bound, removing dispatch will not move step_ms and the candidate must fail its noise bound.

setup_work.build_time: build(context) only resolves the root module target 'gpt2' from context['targets'], resolves the module via context['modules']/context['models'], and performs CPU-side attribute/shape/dtype checks (attn implementation 'eager', activation 'gelu_new', no reorder_and_upcast/scale_attn_by_inverse_layer_idx, all dropout p==0.0, Conv1D weight shapes, float32 parameters, lm_head bias-free). It stores references to the live parameter tensors (never copies, so reset()/load_state_dict and optimizer updates stay authoritative) and returns one replacement callable plus a per-(device,seq_len) cache dict. No CUDA work, no parameter transforms, no graphs, no process-group or DDP changes at build time.
setup_work.runtime_lazy: On the first supported invocation the replacement creates two small constant tensors for that (device, sequence_length): position ids (1,128) int64 (~1 KiB) and the causal additive mask (1,128,128) float32 (~64 KiB), built with the same values the parent recomputes on every forward (arange-based causal boolean, torch.where against 0.0 and torch.finfo(float32).min). They are created once during the first (warmup) invocation and reused for the process lifetime; all weights, activations and gradients are read or computed live on every invocation, so the workload executes on current inputs each time.
setup_work.per_call_work: One Python callable invocation per micro-batch executing ~447 aten dispatches (vs ~670 plus 151 module boundaries in the parent). No extra synchronization is introduced; the parent's per-forward host sync (aten._local_scalar_dense from the padding warning) is removed. Unsupported signatures, devices, dtypes, batch sizes or a failed config probe fall back to the parent reference with distinct route labels (parent:signature_guard / parent:setup_config_unsupported / parent:runtime_error); the fast path reports flat:eager_same_op_sequence via context['record_route'] when taken.
setup_work.memory_impact: Retained steady-state additions are the two hoisted constants (~65 KiB total). No graphs, no pools, no scratch buffers; per-micro-batch activation/gradient allocation and freeing match the parent's op sequence, so warm-run peak_allocated_bytes and lifecycle counters are effectively unchanged (not claimed as a memory saving).

quality_risks: Numerics are designed to be bitwise identical, not merely within tolerance: the flattened forward emits the same compute kernels with the same operand values/layouts as the parent (bmm operands constructed via as_strided with the exact shapes/strides/storage-offsets recorded for the parent's matmul folding; mask add is a broadcast variant with identical elementwise values). CPU verification on the worker's libraries shows bitwise-equal loss, logits, all gradients after 4-micro-batch accumulation and a compute-op skeleton with zero value mismatches, so the 1e-6/1e-4 reference checks, the atol=0/rtol=0 cross-rank replica check, the finite-loss assert and the negative control see the parent's exact values.

as_strided replaces the parent's view/transpose/split metadata chains. Its backward writes each gradient element exactly once (disjoint q/k/v offsets), so assembled gradients remain bitwise equal (verified), but the backward metadata kernels differ slightly from the parent's; only kernel identity changes, not values.

The 150 inner module boundaries no longer execute as Python module calls; their math is emitted directly by the root replacement (listed in eliminated_calls). No framework replacement was installed at those sites, no consumer depends on their boundary side effects (DDP sees only parameters/gradients, observe() consumes the root output and parameter state), and the returned object is the same CausalLMOutputWithCrossAttentions type with the same fields.

If the clean step is GPU-bound rather than launch-paced, the dispatch reduction will not exceed the noise bound and the candidate must be rejected on paired measurement; the expected benefit is a hypothesis, not acceptance.

The replacement self-guards to the observed call shape (kwargs input_ids/labels/use_cache with use_cache falsy, int64 2-D tokens with batch 1 on the model's device); any other signature, an unsupported config probe, or a runtime exception inside the fast path delegates to the parent reference before any state is mutated, so fallback is a clean recompute.
The workload's second, non-requested diagnostic goal (max_rank_nccl_kernel_sum_ms) is unaffected: all NCCL kernels, bucket order and volumes are exactly the parent's.
